name: presentation-generator
what_it_does: Generates high-fidelity slide layouts and visual mockups based on brand guidelines.
input: Data points and brand style requirements
output: Visual layout specifications and chart mockups
example_input: Donut chart: 136 on-time, 6 late. Brand: Navy/Gold. Layout: Executive Summary.
example_output: Slide 1: Background #000080, Text #FFD700, Chart centered with legend on right.
